about_the_game:
This game is a thrilling roguelike shoot-'em-up that combines intense, skill-based 2D action platforming with tight, responsive controls. Fight through alien-infested planets, where every run is a fresh challenge filled with unpredictable enemies, levels, and powerful upgrades.

CHOOSE YOUR HERO

Choose your hero, rescue your captured crew, and build an unstoppable team. Each character comes with unique abilities—like blazing fire rates, devastating power-ups, or versatile jetpacks—allowing you to strategically match your playstyle. With every crew member rescued, your arsenal and strategy evolve dynamically, making every run feel new, challenging, and exhilarating.

OPTIMIZE WITH WEAPONS, ARMOUR AND EQUIPMENT

Customize your characters with an extensive array of weapons, gadgets, and armor. Enhance specific stats like damage, fire rate, and defense, crafting the perfect loadout to match your preferred gameplay style. Experimentation is key—optimize your gear to overcome the ever-changing threats of the roguelike galaxy!

Prepare yourself for relentless action, addictive replayability, and thrilling gameplay loops designed specifically for roguelike fans!

WISHLIST NOW!

name: Autogun Heroes: Supercharged

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.8 GHz Dual Core CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 650, Radeon R7 370 or equivalent with 2 GB of video RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: A keyboard, mouse, or controller is required for gameplay.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Blast your way through alien-infested planets and help Gus rescue his crew, one by one, to save the galaxy. This challenging roguelike 2D action platformer combines intense shoot-'em-up chaos with smooth, responsive controls. Dodge. Roll. Dominate!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish, Spanish - Latin America
